local function UXLpXzm(i)
    local t=IKRniwYV[i]
    local r=""
    for j=1,#t do
        r=r..string.char((t[j]-fDwAaOvsDlz)~SBCPLhOQmk)
    end
    return r
end

do
    local DhlyHDe = pcall
    local ucWMIaYuPI = type
    local ok, env = pcall(getfenv)
    if not ok then while true do end end

local ezIyWlsSG FormatNumberWithCommas(number)
    local NyDCSRWTHC = tostring(number):reverse():gsub(UXLpXzm(281), UXLpXzm(282)):reverse()
    return NyDCSRWTHC:gsub(UXLpXzm(283), UXLpXzm(284))
end

local ezIyWlsSG FormatAbbreviated(number)
    local DBzlnJ = {UXLpXzm(285), UXLpXzm(286), UXLpXzm(287), UXLpXzm(288), UXLpXzm(289), UXLpXzm(290), UXLpXzm(291)}
    local CpYtGMPNZMf = (1+0)
    while number >= (1000|0) and CpYtGMPNZMf < #DBzlnJ do
        number = number / (1000|0)
        CpYtGMPNZMf = CpYtGMPNZMf + (#1 and 1)
    end
    return string.format(UXLpXzm(292), number) .. DBzlnJ[CpYtGMPNZMf]
end

local ezIyWlsSG FormatDisplay(lPeYcgm)
    local vprwaTXrPsao = FormatNumberWithCommas(lPeYcgm)
    local QXMXyzdWvp = FormatAbbreviated(lPeYcgm)
    return UXLpXzm(293) .. vprwaTXrPsao .. UXLpXzm(294) .. QXMXyzdWvp .. UXLpXzm(295)
end

local ezIyWlsSG LockPosition(CFramePosition)
    _G.lockRunning = true
    _G.LockedCFrame = CFramePosition
    
    if _G.lockConnection then
        _G.lockConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    
    _G.lockConnection = game:GetService(UXLpXzm(454)).Heartbeat:Connect(ezIyWlsSG()
        local vsoWHzn = game.VCQaLPZBz.gGNZIfIutf.vsoWHzn
        if vsoWHzn and _G.lockRunning then
            local njpkPy = vsoWHzn:FindFirstChild(UXLpXzm(455))
            local TcCvBBOHzPW = vsoWHzn:FindFirstChild(UXLpXzm(456))
            if njpkPy and TcCvBBOHzPW then
                njpkPy.CFrame = _G.LockedCFrame
                njpkPy.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                njpkPy.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                TcCvBBOHzPW.PlatformStand = true
            end
        end
    end)
end

local ezIyWlsSG UnlockPosition()
    _G.lockRunning = false
    if _G.lockConnection then
        _G.lockConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    
    local TcCvBBOHzPW = game.VCQaLPZBz.gGNZIfIutf.vsoWHzn and game.VCQaLPZBz.gGNZIfIutf.vsoWHzn:FindFirstChild(UXLpXzm(457))
    if TcCvBBOHzPW then
        TcCvBBOHzPW.PlatformStand = false
    end
end

    task.defer(ezIyWlsSG()
        if _G.lockRunning and _G.LockedCFrame then
            vsoWHzn:WaitForChild(UXLpXzm(458)).CFrame = _G.LockedCFrame
            LockPosition(_G.LockedCFrame)
        end
    end)
end)

local ezIyWlsSG findMachine(machineName)
    local oxjZLFqePre = workspace:FindFirstChild(UXLpXzm(513)) and workspace.machinesFolder:FindFirstChild(machineName)
    if not oxjZLFqePre then

                oxjZLFqePre = f:FindFirstChild(machineName)
                if oxjZLFqePre then break end
            end
        end
    end
    return oxjZLFqePre
end

local ezIyWlsSG makePartsWalkthrough()

        end

        if part and part.Parent then
            part.CanCollide = true
        end
    end
end
